indicator.title: CO₂-Intensität des BIP
indicator.description: Kohlendioxid-Emissionen ohne LULUCF je Einheit Wirtschaftsleistung, in kg CO₂e pro 2021-PPP-Dollar des BIP.

source.indicatorName: Carbon intensity of GDP (kg CO2e per 2021 PPP $ of GDP)
source.sourceNote: Annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2), one of the six Kyoto greenhouse gases (GHG), from the agriculture, energy, waste, and industrial sectors, excluding LULUCF divided by the GDP in 2021 PPP $.
